map.折扣率计算器根据原价与折扣率求折后价、节省金额，支持多种折扣形式换算，适合电商促: The discount rate calculator derives the discounted price and savings from the original price and discount rate, supporting conversions between several discount forms, for e-commerce promotions, pricing strategy and consumer price comparison.
map.标原价和折扣力度，算折后价和立省多少。: Enter the original price and discount strength to get the discounted price and the amount saved.
map.已知折后价反推实际折扣率。: Back-derive the effective discount rate from a known discounted price.
map.做「满减/打折」二选一对客展示。: Present customers with a choice between "threshold discount" and "percentage discount".
map.：原价 299、打 8 折（折扣 20%）→ 折后价=299×(1−20%)=2: : original price 299 with 20% off (a 20% discount) -> discounted price = 299 x (1 - 20%) = 239.2 CNY, saving 59.8 CNY.
map.：原价 299、折后 239.2 → 折扣率=(1−239.2/299)×100: : original price 299, discounted 239.2 -> discount rate = (1 - 239.2/299) x 100 = 20%, i.e. 80% of the price.
map.折扣率和折扣力度一样吗？: Are discount rate and discount strength the same?
map.「打 8 折」折扣力度是 20%（省的比例），折扣率有时指最终占比 80%，表述: "20% off" means a 20% discount (the share saved), while "discount rate" sometimes means the final 80% share; the phrasing is easily confused, so state either "save X%" or "Y% of the price" explicitly.
map.先算店铺折扣再减券，顺序影响最终价，本工具按「原价×折扣系数−券」口径，避免资损: Apply the store discount first, then subtract coupons; the order affects the final price, and this tool uses the "original price x discount factor - coupon" basis to avoid margin leakage.
